summary: Single-page UWP sample: a full-window camera preview (CaptureElement) with an overlay Canvas for face-detection bounding boxes, plus three command buttons that are disabled until the camera initializes.

features.name: CameraFaceDetection

controls.expected: Full-window camera preview surface (CaptureElement in UWP -> Image/MediaPlayerElement in WinUI). Blank when no camera.
Canvas overlay hosting face bounding boxes, aligned to the preview.
Camera symbol icon; disabled until camera ready; takes a photo.
Red ellipse (start) / white rectangle (stop) icon; disabled until camera ready; toggles video recording.
Contact / Contact2 icon; disabled until camera ready; toggles face detection.

features.notes: All three buttons start with IsEnabled=False and are only enabled after the camera initializes. On a machine with no camera, the correct faithful behavior is: blank preview and all buttons remaining disabled.
